title: OLEFRAME DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated in-memory OLEFRAME transaction controls only; no producer or support claim.

behavior: Use the shared private entity transaction helper to stage body and handle streams.
Preserve opaque OLE 1 payload bytes, actual payload length, object type, and buffer alias routing.
Keep the existing malformed/truncated/oversized and declared-length mismatch refusals.

assertions: Injected allocation failures return false without throwing.
Seeded body and handle bytes, bit counts, handle occurrences, and prior class ID remain unchanged on failure.
Retrying the same object into the same buffers matches clean output.
All-stream alias controls preserve state and succeed on retry.
limitations: Generated controls establish transaction behavior only.
OLE payload semantics, physical producer coverage, native consumer behavior, and broader support remain unqualified.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
